name: Charlotte La Bouff's Bucatini Pasta
whyItWorks: Thick refined durum-wheat bucatini noodles are gentle, though the standard build tosses in charred baby artichokes, wild mushrooms, and chili flakes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the bucatini pasta tossed simply in butter, olive oil, and aged Parmesan, holding the fibrous artichoke hearts, mushrooms, and chili flakes.
watchOuts: Fibrous artichoke bracts and wild mushrooms
